title: Metaclasses
summary: A metaclass is the type of a class: it prepares the namespace, builds the class and decides what calling it does. Write metaclasses that reject a class at definition time, keep one instance per class without re-running __init__ and forbid subclassing, then resolve a metaclass conflict.
